name: @layera-labs/orbit-ui
description: React component library for the Orbit v1 editor (Tailwind + Radix)
author: Layera Labs
//tailwind.preset: The components emit `bg-orbit-accent`, `rounded-orbit-md` and ~50 other class names in this design system's own namespace; Tailwind emits nothing for a name it has no theme entry for, so before this preset shipped an install produced correctly-structured, entirely unstyled components. It is CJS because this package is "type": "module" and a `tailwind.config.js` still needs to `require()` it. It sits at the package root rather than in dist/ because it is authored, not built, and `files` therefore names it explicitly — `dist` alone would have shipped everything except the one file that makes dist usable.
//bin: An `orbit-ui` bin pointed at ./cli/index.js, a shadcn-style `add <component>` copier. It was removed rather than fixed because it had never run even once as packaged, and was broken twice over: (1) it was CommonJS `require` in a file named .js inside a "type": "module" package, so EVERY invocation — including `help` — died with ReferenceError before parsing an argument; (2) `add` copies from ../src/components/<name>.tsx, and `files` ships only `dist`, so a published install had no source to copy from. Reviving it would mean shipping src/ purely to feed a copier that duplicates what `import { OrbitButton } from '@layera-labs/orbit-ui'` already does.
